name: NaCl
notes: Imported 12.08.2026 from a beamline jcpds collection. Source file(s): JCPDS/current user/jcpds/nacl-b2.jcpds, JCPDS/current user/jcpds/certified data base/nacl-b2.jcpds, JCPDS/current user/jcpds/ver3/naclb2.jcpds

eos_records.label: Heinz and Jeanloz (1984), B2
eos_records.reference: Heinz and Jeanloz, Phys. Rev. B 30, 6045-6050 (1984), doi:10.1103/PhysRevB.30.6045
eos_records.notes: Heinz and Jeanloz report V0(B2)/V0(B1) = 0.929 +/- 0.071 and K0 = 36.2 +/- 4.2 GPa from a second-order finite-strain fit, which fixes K0' at 4. The V0 uncertainty is propagated using the ambient B1 volume. The uncitable Sata/Shen fit was removed.

eos_records.label: Shen and Smith (2026), Cu-referenced Vinet
eos_records.reference: Shen and Smith, Phys. Rev. B 113, 144113 (2026), doi:10.1103/fxgq-96sg
eos_records.notes: Table II Cu-referenced fit using DAC-2 data; V0 fixed. Reported uncertainties: K0 +/- 0.11 GPa and K0' +/- 0.02. The B2 phase data are above 33 GPa.
